purpose: Teach: 宮内庁/日夜/儲ける/コネ/ドロップ/修習/総数/産婆

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、宮内庁御用達を目指せ
lines.en: We should aim to become a purveyor to the Imperial Household.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Sharp enunciation on the key phrase. Decisive tone with no room for negotiation. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、日夜、お客様の信頼に応えております
lines.en: Yes. Our staff work tirelessly to earn our clients' trust every day.
lines.style: Formal, respectful register. Measured cadence. Each clause distinct and deliberate. The tone of someone reporting to a superior with precision and care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外進出で儲けるチャンスだ
lines.en: This is our chance to profit through overseas expansion.
lines.style: Energized shift. Slightly quicker tempo on 'chance.' The word lands with conviction. Forward-leaning, strategic. Fingers might tap the table once.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界のコネを生かして交渉を進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll leverage our industry connections to move negotiations forward.
lines.style: Confident, methodical. Each point lands clearly. Not rushed, but purposeful. The assurance of someone who knows the steps and will execute them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員研修にドロップアウト者を出すな
lines.en: Don't let anyone drop out of the staff training program.
lines.style: Direct command, no softness. Emphasis lands on 'don't.' Sharp finish. The expectation is clear and non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の修習過程を整えております
lines.en: Yes. We're refining the onboarding process for new employees with great care.
lines.style: Respectful and grounded. Slower pace on 'care'—showing that this isn't just procedure but something held with intention. Quiet commitment in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 総数を明確に把握しろ
lines.en: Get a clear count of the total numbers.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. No elaboration. The tone of someone who doesn't repeat himself and expects to be understood immediately.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業期、産婆さんのような心遣いを大切に申し上げます
lines.en: Yes. From our founding, we've held the spirit of a midwife—caring for new growth with attention and gentleness.
lines.style: Warm closing reflection. Slower, more thoughtful pace. The simile lands with quiet reverence. A small exhale before the final phrase, as if this principle matters personally.
